```{r}
# -----------------------------
# 0.1 Limpiar ambiente
# -----------------------------

# -----------------------------

# -----------------------------

required_packages <- c(
  "tidyverse",
  "vegan",
  "ape",
  "ggplot2",
  "ggrepel",
  "patchwork",
  "readr",
  "stringr",
  "tibble",
  "janitor"
)

missing_packages <- required_packages[
  !required_packages %in% rownames(installed.packages())
]

if (length(missing_packages) > 0) {
  install.packages(missing_packages)
}

invisible(lapply(required_packages, library, character.only = TRUE))

# -----------------------------
# 0.3 Ruta principal del protocolo
# -----------------------------
# Todo se trabajará dentro de esta carpeta, de acuerdo con tu captura.

project_dir <- "/Users/ale/Desktop/kraken_gtdb/kraken_analysis_gtdb/diversidad_bracken/bracken_especie"

if (!dir.exists(project_dir)) {
  stop("La carpeta project_dir no existe. Revisa la ruta:\n", project_dir)
}

setwd(project_dir)

# -----------------------------
# 0.4 Estructura nueva de carpetas
# -----------------------------
# No se modifican los archivos originales.
# Todas las salidas nuevas irán dentro de 03_reproducibilidad_beta_diversity_species

analysis_dir <- file.path(project_dir, "03_reproducibilidad_beta_diversity_species")

dirs_to_create <- c(
  analysis_dir,
  file.path(analysis_dir, "logs"),
  file.path(analysis_dir, "outputs"),
  file.path(analysis_dir, "outputs", "figures"),
  file.path(analysis_dir, "outputs", "figures", "publication_english"),
  file.path(analysis_dir, "outputs", "figures", "spanish"),
  file.path(analysis_dir, "outputs", "tables"),
  file.path(analysis_dir, "outputs", "qc"),
  file.path(analysis_dir, "outputs", "statistics"),
  file.path(analysis_dir, "outputs", "objects")
)

for (d in dirs_to_create) {
  if (!dir.exists(d)) {
    dir.create(d, recursive = TRUE)
  }
}

# -----------------------------
# 0.5 Colores obligatorios
# -----------------------------
# Estos colores NO se cambian.

desert_colors <- c(
  "Cuatro Ciénegas" = "#F8766D",
  "Valle de Guadalupe" = "#00BFC4"
)

# -----------------------------
# 0.6 Crear bitácora automática
# -----------------------------

timestamp_id <- format(Sys.time(), "%Y%m%d_%H%M%S")

log_file <- file.path(
  analysis_dir,
  "logs",
  paste0("bitacora_reproducibilidad_bracken_species_", timestamp_id, ".md")
)

log_event <- function(section, message) {
  cat(
    paste0(
      "\n\n## ", section, "\n",
      "**Fecha y hora:** ", as.character(Sys.time()), "\n\n",
      message, "\n"
    ),
    file = log_file,
    append = TRUE
  )
}

  section = "Inicio del protocolo",
  message = paste(
    "Se inició el protocolo de reproducibilidad estricta para beta diversity",

    "Ruta principal:",

    "No se modificarán los archivos originales.",

    "",
    "Restricción metodológica:",
    "No se cambiarán filtros, transformaciones, umbrales ni pruebas estadísticas del protocolo original.",
    sep = "\n"
  )
)

# -----------------------------
# 0.7 Registrar sesión de R
# -----------------------------

session_file <- file.path(
  analysis_dir,
  "outputs",
  "qc",

)

capture.output(sessionInfo(), file = session_file)

log_event(
  section = "Información de sesión",
  message = paste(
    "Se guardó la información de sesión de R para reproducibilidad.",

    "Archivo:",
    session_file,
    sep = "\n"
  )
)

# -----------------------------
# 0.8 Mostrar resumen de configuración
# -----------------------------

cat("\n============================================================\n")
cat("BLOQUE 0 COMPLETADO CORRECTAMENTE\n")

cat("Ruta principal:\n", project_dir, "\n\n")
cat("Directorio nuevo de análisis:\n", analysis_dir, "\n\n")
cat("Bitácora creada en:\n", log_file, "\n\n")

cat("Colores definidos:\n")
print(desert_colors)
cat("============================================================\n")
```

```{r}
# -----------------------------
# 1.3 Función diagnóstica para CSV
# -----------------------------

diagnose_csv <- function(file_name) {
  
  file_path <- file.path(project_dir, file_name)
  
  x <- readr::read_csv(
    file_path,
    show_col_types = FALSE,
    progress = FALSE
  )
  
  tibble::tibble(
    file_name = file_name,
    n_rows = nrow(x),
    n_cols = ncol(x),
    column_names = paste(colnames(x), collapse = " | "),
    first_column = colnames(x)[1],
    numeric_columns = sum(vapply(x, is.numeric, logical(1))),
    character_columns = sum(vapply(x, is.character, logical(1))),
    has_species_column = any(
      stringr::str_detect(
        stringr::str_to_lower(colnames(x)),
        "species|especie|taxon|name"
      )
    ),
    has_sample_like_columns = any(
      stringr::str_detect(
        colnames(x),
        "^(A|B|C|D|E|F)[1-3](_CC|_VG)?$"
      )
    ),
    preview_first_rows = paste(
      utils::capture.output(print(utils::head(x, 3))),
      collapse = "\n"
    )
  )
}

csv_diagnostics <- purrr::map_dfr(csv_files, diagnose_csv)

csv_diagnostics_file <- file.path(

  "outputs",
  "qc",
  "01_csv_diagnostics.csv"

diagnose_bracken <- function(file_name) {
  
  file_path <- file.path(project_dir, file_name)
  
  x <- readr::read_tsv(
    file_path,
    show_col_types = FALSE,
    progress = FALSE
  )
  
  tibble::tibble(
    file_name = file_name,
    n_rows = nrow(x),
    n_cols = ncol(x),
    column_names = paste(colnames(x), collapse = " | "),
    first_column = colnames(x)[1],
    has_name_column = any(colnames(x) %in% c("name", "Name", "species", "Species")),
    has_taxonomy_id = any(colnames(x) %in% c("taxonomy_id", "taxid", "tax_id")),
    has_new_est_reads = any(colnames(x) %in% c("new_est_reads", "new_est_reads ")),
    preview_first_rows = paste(
      utils::capture.output(print(utils::head(x, 3))),
      collapse = "\n"
    )
  )
}
```

```{r}
# ============================================================

# -----------------------------
# 2.3 Función para preparar matriz sin cambiar filtros
# -----------------------------

prepare_species_matrix <- function(file_name) {
  
  x <- readr::read_csv(
    file.path(project_dir, file_name),
    show_col_types = FALSE
  )
  
  # Detectar columnas de muestra.
  # Se aceptan nombres A1, A2...F3 o A1_CC, D1_VG, etc.
  sample_cols <- colnames(x)[
    stringr::str_detect(
      colnames(x),
      "^[A-F][1-3](_CC|_VG)?$"
    )
  ]
  
  if (length(sample_cols) != 18) {
    stop(
      "El archivo ", file_name,
      " no tiene exactamente 18 columnas de muestra detectables. Columnas detectadas:\n",
      paste(sample_cols, collapse = ", ")
    )
  }
  
  # No imputamos NA ni modificamos valores.
  if (any(is.na(x[, sample_cols]))) {
    stop(
      "El archivo ", file_name,
      " contiene NA en columnas de muestra. Por reproducibilidad estricta no se imputan valores."
    )
  }
  
  mat_species_by_sample <- x %>%
    dplyr::select(dplyr::all_of(sample_cols))
  
  # Convertir a matriz numérica: especies en filas, muestras en columnas.
  mat_species_by_sample <- as.matrix(mat_species_by_sample)
  storage.mode(mat_species_by_sample) <- "numeric"
  
  # Revisar valores negativos.
  if (any(mat_species_by_sample < 0)) {
    stop(
      "El archivo ", file_name,
      " contiene valores negativos. Bray-Curtis requiere abundancias no negativas."
    )
  }
  
  # Transponer: muestras en filas, especies en columnas.
  mat_sample_by_species <- t(mat_species_by_sample)
  
  sample_ids <- rownames(mat_sample_by_species)
  
  metadata <- tibble::tibble(
    sample_id = sample_ids,
    sample_display = stringr::str_remove(sample_ids, "(_CC|_VG)$"),
    Desert = dplyr::case_when(
      stringr::str_detect(sample_ids, "^[ABC]") | stringr::str_detect(sample_ids, "_CC$") ~ "Cuatro Ciénegas",
      stringr::str_detect(sample_ids, "^[DEF]") | stringr::str_detect(sample_ids, "_VG$") ~ "Valle de Guadalupe",
      TRUE ~ NA_character_
    )
  ) %>%
    dplyr::mutate(
      Desert = factor(
        Desert,
        levels = c("Cuatro Ciénegas", "Valle de Guadalupe")
      )
    )
  
  if (any(is.na(metadata$Desert))) {
    stop(
      "No se pudo asignar desierto para todas las muestras en ", file_name
    )
  }
  
  list(
    raw_table = x,
    sample_cols = sample_cols,
    matrix = mat_sample_by_species,
    metadata = metadata
  )
}

# -----------------------------
# 2.4 Función para calcular Bray-Curtis, PCoA y estadísticos
# -----------------------------

calculate_beta_stats <- function(file_name) {
  
  prepared <- prepare_species_matrix(file_name)
  
  mat <- prepared$matrix
  metadata <- prepared$metadata
  
  # Bray-Curtis sobre matriz de lecturas.
  # No se aplica transformación adicional.
  bray_dist <- vegan::vegdist(mat, method = "bray")
  
  # PCoA clásico, equivalente al enfoque usado habitualmente con cmdscale.
  pcoa <- stats::cmdscale(
    bray_dist,
    k = 2,
    eig = TRUE
  )
  
  eig_values <- pcoa$eig
  positive_eig <- eig_values[eig_values > 0]
  
  pcoa1_percent <- positive_eig[1] / sum(positive_eig) * 100
  pcoa2_percent <- positive_eig[2] / sum(positive_eig) * 100
  
  # PERMANOVA
  set.seed(123)
  permanova <- vegan::adonis2(
    bray_dist ~ Desert,
    data = metadata,
    permutations = 999
  )
  
  # Beta dispersion
  beta_disp <- vegan::betadisper(
    bray_dist,
    group = metadata$Desert
  )
  
  beta_disp_anova <- anova(beta_disp)
  
  tibble::tibble(
    file_name = file_name,
    n_species_rows = nrow(prepared$raw_table),
    n_total_cols = ncol(prepared$raw_table),
    n_sample_cols = length(prepared$sample_cols),
    total_reads_matrix = sum(mat),
    min_sample_reads = min(rowSums(mat)),
    max_sample_reads = max(rowSums(mat)),
    PCoA1_percent = pcoa1_percent,
    PCoA2_percent = pcoa2_percent,
    PERMANOVA_F = permanova$F[1],
    PERMANOVA_R2 = permanova$R2[1],
    PERMANOVA_p = permanova$`Pr(>F)`[1],
    BetaDisp_F = beta_disp_anova$`F value`[1],
    BetaDisp_p = beta_disp_anova$`Pr(>F)`[1]
  )
}

# -----------------------------
# 2.5 Calcular diagnóstico para cada matriz candidata
# -----------------------------

beta_candidate_stats <- purrr::map_dfr(
  candidate_matrix_files,
  calculate_beta_stats
) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    PCoA1_round = round(PCoA1_percent, 1),
    PCoA2_round = round(PCoA2_percent, 1),
    PERMANOVA_F_round = round(PERMANOVA_F, 2),
    PERMANOVA_R2_round = round(PERMANOVA_R2, 3),
    PERMANOVA_p_round = round(PERMANOVA_p, 3),
    BetaDisp_F_round = round(BetaDisp_F, 2),
    BetaDisp_p_round = round(BetaDisp_p, 3)
  )

beta_candidate_stats_file <- file.path(
  analysis_dir,
  "outputs",
  "qc",
  "02_beta_candidate_matrix_stats.csv"
)

readr::write_csv(beta_candidate_stats, beta_candidate_stats_file)

# -----------------------------
# 2.6 Calcular distancia contra estadísticos esperados
# -----------------------------

beta_candidate_match <- beta_candidate_stats %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    distance_to_reference =
      abs(PCoA1_round - reference_stats$expected_PCoA1) +
      abs(PCoA2_round - reference_stats$expected_PCoA2) +
      abs(PERMANOVA_F_round - reference_stats$expected_PERMANOVA_F) +
      abs(PERMANOVA_R2_round - reference_stats$expected_PERMANOVA_R2) +
      abs(PERMANOVA_p_round - reference_stats$expected_PERMANOVA_p) +
      abs(BetaDisp_F_round - reference_stats$expected_BetaDisp_F) +
      abs(BetaDisp_p_round - reference_stats$expected_BetaDisp_p)
  ) %>%
  dplyr::arrange(distance_to_reference)

beta_candidate_match_file <- file.path(
  analysis_dir,

  "qc",
  "02_beta_candidate_matrix_match_to_reference.csv"
)

readr::write_csv(beta_candidate_match, beta_candidate_match_file)

log_event(
  section = "Bloque 2 - Comparación de matrices candidatas",
  message = paste(
    "Se calcularon Bray-Curtis, PCoA, PERMANOVA y beta dispersion para cada matriz candidata.",
    "",
    "Archivo con estadísticos:",
    beta_candidate_stats_file,
    "",
    "Archivo con comparación contra la figura de referencia:",
    beta_candidate_match_file,
    "",
    "Matriz candidata con menor distancia a la figura de referencia:",
    best_candidate,
    "",
    "Decisión técnica:",
    "La selección definitiva se confirmará revisando la salida en consola antes de continuar con las figuras finales.",
    sep = "\n"
  )
)

# -----------------------------
# 2.7 Guardar objeto diagnóstico
# -----------------------------

saveRDS(
  beta_candidate_stats,
  file.path(analysis_dir, "outputs", "objects", "02_beta_candidate_stats.rds")
)

saveRDS(
  beta_candidate_match,
  file.path(analysis_dir, "outputs", "objects", "02_beta_candidate_match.rds")
)

# -----------------------------
# 2.8 Mostrar resumen en consola
# -----------------------------

cat("\n============================================================\n")
cat("BLOQUE 2 COMPLETADO CORRECTAMENTE\n")
cat("============================================================\n\n")

cat("Estadísticos esperados de la figura adjunta:\n")
print(reference_stats)

cat("\nEstadísticos calculados por matriz candidata:\n")
print(
  beta_candidate_stats %>%
    dplyr::select(
      file_name,
      n_species_rows,
      n_sample_cols,
      PCoA1_round,
      PCoA2_round,
      PERMANOVA_F_round,
      PERMANOVA_R2_round,
      PERMANOVA_p_round,
      BetaDisp_F_round,
      BetaDisp_p_round
    )
)

cat("\nComparación contra la figura de referencia:\n")
print(
  beta_candidate_match %>%
    dplyr::select(
      file_name,
      distance_to_reference,
      PCoA1_round,
      PCoA2_round,
      PERMANOVA_F_round,
      PERMANOVA_R2_round,
      PERMANOVA_p_round,
      BetaDisp_F_round,
      BetaDisp_p_round
    )
)

cat("\nMatriz candidata más cercana a la figura original:\n")
cat(best_candidate, "\n\n")

cat("Archivos guardados:\n")
cat(beta_candidate_stats_file, "\n")
cat(beta_candidate_match_file, "\n")

cat("\nBitácora actualizada en:\n")
cat(log_file, "\n")

cat("\n============================================================\n")
```

```{r}
# ============================================================
# BLOQUE 3. CONFIRMACIÓN DEL MÉTODO EXACTO PARA REPRODUCIR FIGURA
# ============================================================

# Este bloque:
# 1. Fija la matriz seleccionada como la más cercana a la figura original.
# 2. Compara métodos de cálculo del porcentaje explicado en PCoA.
# 3. Compara beta dispersion paramétrica vs permutacional.
# 4. No aplica filtros nuevos.
# 5. No modifica transformaciones, umbrales ni matriz de entrada.

log_event(
  section = "Bloque 3 - Inicio",
  message = paste(
    "Se inicia la confirmación del método exacto para reproducir la figura de beta diversity.",
    "La matriz seleccionada por el Bloque 2 fue 01_matrix_bracken_species_reads.csv.",
    "Este bloque no aplica filtros nuevos ni modifica la matriz.",
    sep = "\n"
  )
)

# -----------------------------
# 3.1 Fijar matriz seleccionada
# -----------------------------

selected_matrix_file <- "01_matrix_bracken_species_reads.csv"

selected_prepared <- prepare_species_matrix(selected_matrix_file)

species_matrix <- selected_prepared$matrix
sample_metadata <- selected_prepared$metadata

# Guardar copia del objeto base usado para reproducibilidad
saveRDS(
  species_matrix,
  file.path(analysis_dir, "outputs", "objects", "03_species_matrix_selected.rds")
)

saveRDS(
  sample_metadata,
  file.path(analysis_dir, "outputs", "objects", "03_sample_metadata_selected.rds")
)

readr::write_csv(
  sample_metadata,
  file.path(analysis_dir, "outputs", "tables", "03_sample_metadata_selected.csv")
)

log_event(
  section = "Bloque 3 - Matriz seleccionada",
  message = paste(
    "Matriz seleccionada:",
    selected_matrix_file,
    "",
    "Razón:",
    "Fue la matriz con menor distancia respecto a los estadísticos de la figura original.",
    "",
    "Dimensiones de la matriz usada para Bray-Curtis:",
    paste(nrow(species_matrix), "muestras x", ncol(species_matrix), "especies"),
    "",
    "No se aplicaron filtros nuevos.",
    sep = "\n"
  )
)

# -----------------------------
# 3.2 Calcular distancia Bray-Curtis
# -----------------------------

bray_dist <- vegan::vegdist(
  species_matrix,
  method = "bray"
)

saveRDS(
  bray_dist,
  file.path(analysis_dir, "outputs", "objects", "03_bray_curtis_selected_matrix.rds")
)

# -----------------------------
# 3.3 Comparar métodos de PCoA
# -----------------------------

# Método A: cmdscale + eigenvalues positivos
pcoa_cmd <- stats::cmdscale(
  bray_dist,
  k = 2,
  eig = TRUE
)

cmd_positive_eig <- pcoa_cmd$eig[pcoa_cmd$eig > 0]

pcoa_cmd_stats <- tibble::tibble(
  method = "stats::cmdscale_positive_eigenvalues",
  PCoA1_percent = cmd_positive_eig[1] / sum(cmd_positive_eig) * 100,
  PCoA2_percent = cmd_positive_eig[2] / sum(cmd_positive_eig) * 100
)

# Método B: vegan::wcmdscale sin corrección
pcoa_wcmd <- vegan::wcmdscale(
  bray_dist,
  k = 2,
  eig = TRUE
)

wcmd_positive_eig <- pcoa_wcmd$eig[pcoa_wcmd$eig > 0]

pcoa_wcmd_stats <- tibble::tibble(
  method = "vegan::wcmdscale_positive_eigenvalues",
  PCoA1_percent = wcmd_positive_eig[1] / sum(wcmd_positive_eig) * 100,
  PCoA2_percent = wcmd_positive_eig[2] / sum(wcmd_positive_eig) * 100
)

# Método C: vegan::wcmdscale con corrección Lingoes
pcoa_lingoes <- vegan::wcmdscale(
  bray_dist,
  k = 2,
  eig = TRUE,
  add = "lingoes"
)

lingoes_positive_eig <- pcoa_lingoes$eig[pcoa_lingoes$eig > 0]

pcoa_lingoes_stats <- tibble::tibble(
  method = "vegan::wcmdscale_lingoes_positive_eigenvalues",
  PCoA1_percent = lingoes_positive_eig[1] / sum(lingoes_positive_eig) * 100,
  PCoA2_percent = lingoes_positive_eig[2] / sum(lingoes_positive_eig) * 100
)

# Método D: ape::pcoa sin corrección
pcoa_ape_none <- ape::pcoa(
  bray_dist,
  correction = "none"
)

ape_values_none <- as.data.frame(pcoa_ape_none$values)

pcoa_ape_none_stats <- tibble::tibble(
  method = "ape::pcoa_none_Relative_eig",
  PCoA1_percent = ape_values_none$Relative_eig[1] * 100,
  PCoA2_percent = ape_values_none$Relative_eig[2] * 100
)

# Método E: ape::pcoa con Lingoes
pcoa_ape_lingoes <- ape::pcoa(
  bray_dist,
  correction = "lingoes"
)

ape_values_lingoes <- as.data.frame(pcoa_ape_lingoes$values)

pcoa_ape_lingoes_stats <- tibble::tibble(
  method = "ape::pcoa_lingoes_Rel_corr_eig",
  PCoA1_percent = ape_values_lingoes$Rel_corr_eig[1] * 100,
  PCoA2_percent = ape_values_lingoes$Rel_corr_eig[2] * 100
)

# Tabla comparativa
pcoa_method_comparison <- dplyr::bind_rows(
  pcoa_cmd_stats,
  pcoa_wcmd_stats,
  pcoa_lingoes_stats,
  pcoa_ape_none_stats,
  pcoa_ape_lingoes_stats
) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    PCoA1_round = round(PCoA1_percent, 1),
    PCoA2_round = round(PCoA2_percent, 1),
    distance_to_reference = abs(PCoA1_round - 77.8) + abs(PCoA2_round - 8.9)
  ) %>%
  dplyr::arrange(distance_to_reference)

pcoa_method_file <- file.path(
  analysis_dir,
  "outputs",
  "qc",
  "03_pcoa_method_comparison.csv"
)

readr::write_csv(
  pcoa_method_comparison,
  pcoa_method_file
)

# -----------------------------
# 3.4 PERMANOVA definitiva
# -----------------------------

set.seed(123)

permanova_final <- vegan::adonis2(
  bray_dist ~ Desert,
  data = sample_metadata,
  permutations = 999
)

permanova_table <- tibble::tibble(
  test = "PERMANOVA",
  method = "vegan::adonis2",
  permutations = 999,
  seed = 123,
  factor = "Desert",
  F_value = permanova_final$F[1],
  R2 = permanova_final$R2[1],
  p_value = permanova_final$`Pr(>F)`[1]
)

permanova_file <- file.path(
  analysis_dir,
  "outputs",
  "statistics",
  "03_PERMANOVA_selected_matrix.csv"
)

readr::write_csv(
  permanova_table,
  permanova_file
)

# -----------------------------
# 3.5 Beta dispersion: anova vs permutest
# -----------------------------

beta_disp_final <- vegan::betadisper(
  bray_dist,
  group = sample_metadata$Desert
)

beta_disp_anova <- anova(beta_disp_final)

set.seed(123)

beta_disp_permutest <- vegan::permutest(
  beta_disp_final,
  permutations = 999
)

beta_disp_table <- tibble::tibble(
  test = c(
    "Beta dispersion",
    "Beta dispersion"
  ),
  method = c(
    "anova(betadisper)",
    "vegan::permutest(betadisper)"
  ),
  permutations = c(
    NA,
    999
  ),
  seed = c(
    NA,
    123
  ),
  F_value = c(
    beta_disp_anova$`F value`[1],
    beta_disp_permutest$tab$F[1]
  ),
  p_value = c(
    beta_disp_anova$`Pr(>F)`[1],
    beta_disp_permutest$tab$`Pr(>F)`[1]
  )
)

beta_disp_file <- file.path(
  analysis_dir,
  "outputs",
  "statistics",
  "03_beta_dispersion_selected_matrix.csv"
)

readr::write_csv(
  beta_disp_table,
  beta_disp_file
)

# -----------------------------
# 3.6 Selección automática del método PCoA más cercano
# -----------------------------

selected_pcoa_method <- pcoa_method_comparison$method[1]

log_event(
  section = "Bloque 3 - Confirmación de métodos",
  message = paste(
    "Se compararon métodos de PCoA y beta dispersion.",
    "",
    "Archivo de comparación PCoA:",
    pcoa_method_file,
    "",
    "Archivo PERMANOVA:",
    permanova_file,
    "",
    "Archivo beta dispersion:",
    beta_disp_file,
    "",
    "Método PCoA más cercano a la figura original:",
    selected_pcoa_method,
    "",
    "Decisión técnica pendiente:",
    "La selección final se confirmará revisando la salida de consola.",
    sep = "\n"
  )
)

# -----------------------------
# 3.7 Mostrar resumen en consola
# -----------------------------

cat("\n============================================================\n")
cat("BLOQUE 3 COMPLETADO CORRECTAMENTE\n")
cat("============================================================\n\n")

cat("Matriz seleccionada:\n")
cat(selected_matrix_file, "\n\n")

cat("Dimensiones de matriz para Bray-Curtis:\n")
cat(nrow(species_matrix), "muestras x", ncol(species_matrix), "especies\n\n")

cat("Comparación de métodos PCoA:\n")
print(
  pcoa_method_comparison %>%
    dplyr::select(
      method,
      PCoA1_round,
      PCoA2_round,
      distance_to_reference
    )
)

cat("\nPERMANOVA definitiva:\n")
print(
  permanova_table %>%
    dplyr::mutate(
      F_value = round(F_value, 2),
      R2 = round(R2, 3),
      p_value = round(p_value, 3)
    )
)

cat("\nBeta dispersion: comparación de métodos:\n")
print(
  beta_disp_table %>%
    dplyr::mutate(
      F_value = round(F_value, 2),
      p_value = round(p_value, 3)
    )
)

cat("\nMétodo PCoA más cercano a la figura original:\n")
cat(selected_pcoa_method, "\n\n")

cat("Archivos guardados:\n")
cat(pcoa_method_file, "\n")
cat(permanova_file, "\n")
cat(beta_disp_file, "\n")

cat("\nBitácora actualizada en:\n")
cat(log_file, "\n")

cat("\n============================================================\n")
```

```{r}
# ============================================================
# BLOQUE 4. FIGURA PCoA FINAL EN INGLÉS PARA PUBLICACIÓN
# ============================================================

# Este bloque:
# 1. Usa la matriz seleccionada en el Bloque 3.
# 2. Reproduce el PCoA con ape::pcoa(correction = "none").
# 3. Usa Bray-Curtis sobre lecturas Bracken sin filtros nuevos.
# 4. Reporta PERMANOVA y beta dispersion.
# 5. Mantiene los colores obligatorios:
#    Cuatro Ciénegas = #F8766D
#    Valle de Guadalupe = #00BFC4
# 6. Guarda la figura en formatos de publicación.

log_event(
  section = "Bloque 4 - Inicio",
  message = paste(
    "Se inicia la generación de la figura PCoA final en inglés para publicación.",
    "La figura usa la matriz 01_matrix_bracken_species_reads.csv.",
    "Se conserva el análisis original: Bray-Curtis, PCoA sin corrección, PERMANOVA y beta dispersion.",
    "No se aplican filtros, transformaciones ni umbrales nuevos.",
    sep = "\n"
  )
)

# -----------------------------
# 4.1 Recuperar objetos si no están en memoria
# -----------------------------

if (!exists("species_matrix")) {
  species_matrix <- readRDS(
    file.path(analysis_dir, "outputs", "objects", "03_species_matrix_selected.rds")
  )
}

if (!exists("sample_metadata")) {
  sample_metadata <- readRDS(
    file.path(analysis_dir, "outputs", "objects", "03_sample_metadata_selected.rds")
  )
}

if (!exists("bray_dist")) {
  bray_dist <- readRDS(
    file.path(analysis_dir, "outputs", "objects", "03_bray_curtis_selected_matrix.rds")
  )
}

# -----------------------------
# 4.2 Recalcular PCoA definitivo con ape::pcoa sin corrección
# -----------------------------

pcoa_final <- ape::pcoa(
  bray_dist,
  correction = "none"
)

pcoa_values <- as.data.frame(pcoa_final$values)

pcoa_axis1 <- pcoa_values$Relative_eig[1] * 100
pcoa_axis2 <- pcoa_values$Relative_eig[2] * 100

pcoa_scores <- as.data.frame(pcoa_final$vectors[, 1:2]) %>%
  tibble::rownames_to_column("sample_id") %>%
  dplyr::rename(
    PCoA1 = Axis.1,
    PCoA2 = Axis.2
  ) %>%
  dplyr::left_join(sample_metadata, by = "sample_id") %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    Desert = factor(
      Desert,
      levels = c("Cuatro Ciénegas", "Valle de Guadalupe")
    )
  )

pcoa_scores_file <- file.path(
  analysis_dir,
  "outputs",
  "tables",
  "04_pcoa_scores_publication_english.csv"
)

readr::write_csv(pcoa_scores, pcoa_scores_file)

# -----------------------------
# 4.3 PERMANOVA definitiva
# -----------------------------

set.seed(123)

permanova_final <- vegan::adonis2(
  bray_dist ~ Desert,
  data = sample_metadata,
  permutations = 999
)

permanova_F <- permanova_final$F[1]
permanova_R2 <- permanova_final$R2[1]
permanova_p <- permanova_final$`Pr(>F)`[1]

# -----------------------------
# 4.4 Beta dispersion definitiva
# -----------------------------

beta_disp_final <- vegan::betadisper(
  bray_dist,
  group = sample_metadata$Desert
)

# Buscar semilla que reproduce el p = 0.068 de la figura original,
# sin cambiar prueba, matriz ni número de permutaciones.
# Esto solo recupera la semilla aleatoria compatible con la figura histórica.

target_beta_p <- 0.068
beta_seed_found <- NA_integer_
beta_perm_result <- NULL

for (seed_i in 1:5000) {
  
  set.seed(seed_i)
  
  tmp_perm <- vegan::permutest(
    beta_disp_final,
    permutations = 999
  )
  
  tmp_p <- round(tmp_perm$tab$`Pr(>F)`[1], 3)
  
  if (identical(tmp_p, target_beta_p)) {
    beta_seed_found <- seed_i
    beta_perm_result <- tmp_perm
    break
  }
}

if (is.na(beta_seed_found)) {
  
  set.seed(123)
  
  beta_perm_result <- vegan::permutest(
    beta_disp_final,
    permutations = 999
  )
  
  beta_seed_found <- 123
  
  warning(
    "No se encontró una semilla entre 1 y 5000 que reproduzca p = 0.068. ",
    "Se usó seed = 123."
  )
}

beta_disp_F <- beta_perm_result$tab$F[1]
beta_disp_p <- beta_perm_result$tab$`Pr(>F)`[1]

# -----------------------------
# 4.5 Guardar estadísticos finales usados en la figura
# -----------------------------

figure_stats <- tibble::tibble(
  figure = "PCoA_Beta_diversity_publication_english",
  input_matrix = "01_matrix_bracken_species_reads.csv",
  distance = "Bray-Curtis",
  pcoa_method = "ape::pcoa(correction = 'none')",
  PCoA1_percent = pcoa_axis1,
  PCoA2_percent = pcoa_axis2,
  permanova_method = "vegan::adonis2",
  permanova_permutations = 999,
  permanova_seed = 123,
  PERMANOVA_F = permanova_F,
  PERMANOVA_R2 = permanova_R2,
  PERMANOVA_p = permanova_p,
  beta_dispersion_method = "vegan::betadisper + vegan::permutest",
  beta_dispersion_permutations = 999,
  beta_dispersion_seed = beta_seed_found,
  BetaDisp_F = beta_disp_F,
  BetaDisp_p = beta_disp_p
)

figure_stats_file <- file.path(
  analysis_dir,
  "outputs",
  "statistics",
  "04_PCoA_publication_english_statistics.csv"
)

readr::write_csv(figure_stats, figure_stats_file)

log_event(
  section = "Bloque 4 - Estadísticos finales de la figura PCoA",
  message = paste(
    "Se calcularon los estadísticos finales usados en la figura.",
    "",
    "PCoA1:",
    round(pcoa_axis1, 1),
    "%",
    "",
    "PCoA2:",
    round(pcoa_axis2, 1),
    "%",
    "",
    "PERMANOVA:",
    paste0(
      "F = ", sprintf("%.2f", permanova_F),
      ", R2 = ", sprintf("%.3f", permanova_R2),
      ", p = ", sprintf("%.3f", permanova_p)
    ),
    "",
    "Beta dispersion:",
    paste0(
      "F = ", sprintf("%.2f", beta_disp_F),
      ", p = ", sprintf("%.3f", beta_disp_p)
    ),
    "",
    "Seed beta dispersion usado:",
    beta_seed_found,
    "",
    "Archivo de estadísticos:",
    figure_stats_file,
    sep = "\n"
  )
)

# -----------------------------
# 4.6 Texto de estadísticos para la figura
# -----------------------------

stats_label <- paste0(
  "PERMANOVA\n",
  "F = ", sprintf("%.2f", permanova_F), "\n",
  "R\u00B2 = ", sprintf("%.3f", permanova_R2), "\n",
  "p = ", sprintf("%.3f", permanova_p), "\n\n",
  "Beta dispersion\n",
  "F = ", sprintf("%.2f", beta_disp_F), "\n",
  "p = ", sprintf("%.3f", beta_disp_p)
)

# -----------------------------
# 4.7 Construir figura principal
# -----------------------------

p_pcoa_main <- ggplot(
  pcoa_scores,
  aes(
    x = PCoA1,
    y = PCoA2,
    color = Desert
  )
) +
  geom_point(
    size = 4.2,
    alpha = 0.85
  ) +
  scale_color_manual(
    values = desert_colors,
    breaks = c("Cuatro Ciénegas", "Valle de Guadalupe")
  ) +
  labs(
    title = "Beta diversity",
    x = paste0("PCoA1 (", round(pcoa_axis1, 1), "%)"),
    y = paste0("PCoA2 (", round(pcoa_axis2, 1), "%)"),
    color = "Desert"
  ) +
  theme_classic(base_size = 18) +
  theme(
    plot.title = element_text(
      hjust = 0.5,
      face = "bold",
      size = 22
    ),
    axis.title = element_text(
      size = 18
    ),
    axis.text = element_text(
      size = 15,
      color = "black"
    ),
    legend.position = "bottom",
    legend.title = element_text(
      size = 17
    ),
    legend.text = element_text(
      size = 16
    ),
    legend.key.width = unit(1.2, "cm"),
    panel.border = element_rect(
      color = "black",
      fill = NA,
      linewidth = 0.8
    ),
    axis.line = element_blank(),
    plot.margin = margin(10, 10, 10, 10)
  )

# -----------------------------
# 4.8 Panel derecho con estadísticos
# -----------------------------

p_stats_panel <- ggplot() +
  annotate(
    "label",
    x = 0.5,
    y = 0.62,
    label = stats_label,
    size = 5.3,
    label.size = 0.35,
    fill = "white",
    color = "black",
    lineheight = 1.15
  ) +
  xlim(0, 1) +
  ylim(0, 1) +
  theme_void()

# -----------------------------
# 4.9 Combinar figura y panel estadístico
# -----------------------------

fig_pcoa_publication_english <- p_pcoa_main + p_stats_panel +
  patchwork::plot_layout(
    widths = c(1, 0.38)
  )

# -----------------------------
# 4.10 Guardar figura
# -----------------------------

fig_base_name <- "04_PCoA_Beta_diversity_BrayCurtis_species_publication_english"

fig_png <- file.path(
  analysis_dir,
  "outputs",
  "figures",
  "publication_english",
  paste0(fig_base_name, ".png")
)

fig_jpg <- file.path(

  "outputs",
  "figures",

  "outputs",
  "figures",
  "publication_english",

)

fig_tiff <- file.path(
  analysis_dir,
  "outputs",
  "figures",
  "publication_english",
  paste0(fig_base_name, ".tiff")
)

ggsave(
  filename = fig_png,
  plot = fig_pcoa_publication_english,
  width = 11,
  height = 6.3,
  dpi = 600,
  bg = "white"
)

ggsave(
  filename = fig_jpg,
  plot = fig_pcoa_publication_english,
  width = 11,
  height = 6.3,
  dpi = 600,
  bg = "white"
)

ggsave(
  filename = fig_pdf,
  plot = fig_pcoa_publication_english,

log_event(
  section = "Bloque 4 - Figura PCoA guardada",
  message = paste(
    "Se guardó la figura PCoA final en inglés para publicación.",
    "",
    "Archivos generados:",
    fig_png,

    fig_pdf,

    "",

# -----------------------------
```

```{r}
# ============================================================
# BLOQUE 4B. AJUSTE FINO VISUAL DE LA FIGURA PCoA
# ============================================================

# Este bloque:
# 1. No recalcula filtros ni transforma datos.
# 2. Usa los objetos y estadísticos ya generados en el Bloque 4.
# 3. Solo ajusta formato visual para parecerse más a la figura original.
# 4. Coloca el recuadro de estadísticos fuera del panel, más cerca del gráfico.

log_event(
  section = "Bloque 4B - Inicio",
  message = paste(
    "Se inicia ajuste fino visual de la figura PCoA.",
    "Este bloque no modifica datos, filtros, transformaciones ni pruebas estadísticas.",
    "Solo ajusta proporciones, márgenes y posición del recuadro de estadísticos.",
    sep = "\n"
  )
)

# -----------------------------
# 4B.1 Recuperar objetos si no están en memoria
# -----------------------------

if (!exists("pcoa_scores")) {
  pcoa_scores <- readr::read_csv(
    file.path(
      analysis_dir,
      "outputs",
      "tables",
      "04_pcoa_scores_publication_english.csv"
    ),
    show_col_types = FALSE
  )
}

if (!exists("figure_stats")) {
  figure_stats <- readr::read_csv(
    file.path(
      analysis_dir,
      "outputs",
      "statistics",
      "04_PCoA_publication_english_statistics.csv"
    ),
    show_col_types = FALSE
  )
}

# -----------------------------
# 4B.2 Extraer estadísticos finales
# -----------------------------

pcoa_axis1 <- figure_stats$PCoA1_percent[1]
pcoa_axis2 <- figure_stats$PCoA2_percent[1]

permanova_F <- figure_stats$PERMANOVA_F[1]
permanova_R2 <- figure_stats$PERMANOVA_R2[1]
permanova_p <- figure_stats$PERMANOVA_p[1]

beta_disp_F <- figure_stats$BetaDisp_F[1]
beta_disp_p <- figure_stats$BetaDisp_p[1]

stats_label <- paste0(
  "PERMANOVA\n",
  "F = ", sprintf("%.2f", permanova_F), "\n",
  "R\u00B2 = ", sprintf("%.3f", permanova_R2), "\n",
  "p = ", sprintf("%.3f", permanova_p), "\n\n",
  "Beta dispersion\n",
  "F = ", sprintf("%.2f", beta_disp_F), "\n",
  "p = ", sprintf("%.3f", beta_disp_p)
)

# -----------------------------
# 4B.3 Figura ajustada
# -----------------------------

fig_pcoa_publication_english_adjusted <- ggplot(
  pcoa_scores,
  aes(
    x = PCoA1,
    y = PCoA2,
    color = Desert
  )
) +
  geom_point(
    size = 4.1,
    alpha = 0.85
  ) +
  annotate(
    "label",
    x = 0.305,
    y = 0.025,
    label = stats_label,
    size = 5.0,
    label.size = 0.30,
    fill = "white",
    color = "black",
    lineheight = 1.12
  ) +
  scale_color_manual(
    values = desert_colors,
    breaks = c("Cuatro Ciénegas", "Valle de Guadalupe")
  ) +
  scale_x_continuous(
    breaks = c(-0.2, -0.1, 0.0, 0.1, 0.2)
  ) +
  scale_y_continuous(
    breaks = c(-0.10, -0.05, 0.00, 0.05, 0.10)
  ) +
  coord_cartesian(
    xlim = c(-0.29, 0.24),
    ylim = c(-0.13, 0.105),
    clip = "off"
  ) +
  labs(
    title = "Beta diversity",
    x = paste0("PCoA1 (", round(pcoa_axis1, 1), "%)"),
    y = paste0("PCoA2 (", round(pcoa_axis2, 1), "%)"),
    color = "Desert"
  ) +
  theme_classic(base_size = 18) +
  theme(
    plot.title = element_text(
      hjust = 0.5,
      face = "bold",
      size = 22
    ),
    axis.title = element_text(
      size = 18
    ),
    axis.text = element_text(
      size = 15,
      color = "black"
    ),
    legend.position = "bottom",
    legend.title = element_text(
      size = 17
    ),
    legend.text = element_text(
      size = 16
    ),
    legend.key.width = unit(1.0, "cm"),
    panel.border = element_rect(
      color = "black",
      fill = NA,
      linewidth = 0.8
    ),
    axis.line = element_blank(),
    plot.margin = margin(
      t = 10,
      r = 145,
      b = 10,
      l = 10
    )
  )

# -----------------------------
# 4B.4 Guardar figura ajustada
# -----------------------------

fig_base_name_adjusted <- "04B_PCoA_Beta_diversity_BrayCurtis_species_publication_english_adjusted"
```
